# Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.

Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a prominent chemical enterprise headquartered at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. Strategically located in one of China's most economically vibrant and innovative regions, the company has established itself as a leading manufacturer and supplier of specialty chemical new materials, with a strong focus on organosilicon products and related chemical solutions.

Since its establishment, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical has been committed to research, development, production, and marketing of high-performance chemical materials that serve a wide range of industries, including textiles, construction, personal care, agriculture, coatings, and more. The company has built a comprehensive product portfolio that includes silicone oils, silicone emulsions, silicone resins, textile auxiliaries, and various other specialty chemical products designed to meet the evolving demands of both domestic and international markets.

With a strong emphasis on technological innovation and quality control, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical has invested significantly in state-of-the-art production facilities and R&D capabilities. The company employs a team of experienced chemists and engineers dedicated to developing cutting-edge solutions that enhance product performance and sustainability.

Over the years, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. has earned a solid reputation for delivering reliable, high-quality products and excellent customer service, forging lasting partnerships with clients across the globe and continuously expanding its presence in the international chemical industry.
